hypothesis: Later reconstruction feature response retains development-label association beyond first-step amplitude.
alternative: Later response is explained by first-step scale and domain, or no consistent label association remains.
fixed_inputs: Existing 192 development videos, one frame/video; manifest ac5121d948e23b5c00f36b30e606224380e2ef18a566a04c4dae8c60438e988a. Pretrained CLIP with zero-update LoRA, frozen eval, existing frozen VAE. No trained checkpoint or classifier head.
trajectory: x0=current normalized image; xk=VAE(x[k-1]) for k=1..3; no extra clamp/quantization. Same existing resize/normalization each time. Record pixel RGB RMS and feature L2 successive differences and ratios to first step; finite output and first batch repeatability checks.
primary: Within each domain regress log feature step3 on intercept and log feature step1 (unlabeled OLS), compute residual AUC against video label. Prespecified two-sided association: abs(macro AUC-.5)>=.10, all three domains same direction, stratified video-label permutation p<=.05, exactly1000 permutations seed20261005. Otherwise criterion not supported.
secondary: Pixel/feature median step energies and decay ratios descriptive only, no choosing the best step or metric after results.
limitations: Only log-linear first-amplitude adjustment, not full conditional independence; repeated target development data and shared identity dependencies; no manifold or independent final-test proof.
dedup: One-step N01/N02 and signed/abs T04 do not measure iterative reconstruction. 4090 N07 owns learning curves and source selection, not dynamics.
